Reverie Labs (reverielabs.com), a Cambridge, MA (Boston-area) company founded in 2017 by Jonah Kallenbach (CEO) and Ankit Gupta (CTO) that used machine learning to design brain-penetrant kinase inhibitors for cancer; a Y Combinator alum. Closed a $25M Series A led by Ridgeback Capital Investments with First Round Capital, Y Combinator and Neo in Feb 2021, which the company said brought total capital raised to more than $32M. The amount_raised is that 'more than $32M' floor. Pre-Series A rounds (about $7M) aren't itemized publicly. In Feb 2024 Ginkgo Bioworks acquired Reverie's key assets (AI infrastructure, software and models), and four team members including CTO Ankit Gupta joined Ginkgo; terms not disclosed.
